title.bn: break দিয়ে থামা ও continue দিয়ে পরের ধাপে যাওয়া

summary.en: Break leaves the nearest loop or switch.
summary.bn: loop থামানো আর একটি iteration-এর বাকি কাজ বাদ দেওয়ার পার্থক্য trace করো।

notes: Break and continue are available throughout C89 to C23. The destination of continue depends on the loop form, not the language edition. These C17 examples keep counter updates in predictable locations.

examples.title: Skip evens and stop at seven
examples.explanationHtml: Even values skip the print but still reach the for update. Seven takes break before any print or update for that iteration. The output contains one, three and five. The two transfers have distinct roles in the trace.

examples.title: Leave nested loops with a flag
examples.explanationHtml: The search reaches row two, column two first. Break exits the inner loop and found prevents another outer body. Without the flag test, the outer progression would continue to row three even though one result had already been located.

examples.title: A named exit after both loops
examples.explanationHtml: The first matching pair is row one and column three. The jump reaches a label after both loops, then prints Done. This is a deliberate whole-search exit; ordinary break at the same location would end only the inner loop.

practice.title: Stop before a bound
practice.statementHtml: Read stop 1 to 10. After the prompt Input: , print integers from 1 up to but excluding stop, one per line. Use break.
hints: Check the stop value before printing.

practice.title: Skip multiples of three
practice.statementHtml: Read n 0 to 20. After the prompt Input: , print numbers 1 through n that are not divisible by 3, one per line.
hints: Continue should skip only the output.

practice.title: First divisor
practice.statementHtml: Read n 2 to 100. After the prompt Input: , print the smallest divisor from 2 through n and newline.
hints: The first match ends the search.

practice.title: First grid product match
practice.statementHtml: Read target 1 to 20. Search row and col from 1 to 3 in row-major order. After the prompt Input: , print the first pair whose product equals target, separated by one space and newline. If no pair exists print None.
hints: Carry the match state to the outer condition.

options: The nearest enclosing loop or switch
quiz.explanation: Its target is the nearest breakable construct.

quiz.prompt: Where does continue go in a for loop?
quiz.explanation: The next condition follows the update.

quiz.prompt: Where does continue go in a while loop?
options: To a skipped bottom update automatically
quiz.explanation: Body statements after continue do not run.

quiz.prompt: What does an inner-loop break do to an outer loop?
options: The outer loop may still continue
quiz.explanation: A separate outer exit rule is needed.

quiz.prompt: Which state can stop both loops after a search match?
options: A found flag tested by the outer condition
quiz.explanation: The flag carries the exit reason across levels.

quiz.prompt: A break in a switch inside a loop normally leaves which construct?
quiz.explanation: Switch is the nearest breakable construct.

quiz.prompt: What must every repeating continue path preserve?
options: Progress toward the next terminating test
quiz.explanation: Skipping the only update can make the loop infinite.

quiz.prompt: Break occurs at three before printing. Which digits remain?
quiz.explanation: Only one and two print before the break.

quiz.prompt: Continue skips three but keeps later iterations. Which digits appear?
quiz.explanation: The update still advances past three, so four and five print.

quiz.prompt: Each inner break leaves the outer loop active. How many visits occur?
quiz.explanation: Each of three outer iterations visits the inner body once.

keyPoints.en: Break leaves the nearest loop or switch.
keyPoints.bn: break সবচেয়ে ভেতরের loop বা switch ছাড়ে।

keyPoints.en: Continue skips the rest of the current iteration.
keyPoints.bn: continue বর্তমান iteration-এর বাকি কাজ বাদ দেয়।

keyPoints.en: For continue still reaches the for update.
keyPoints.bn: for-এ continue হলেও update অংশ চলে।

keyPoints.en: While continue returns directly to its condition.
An outer flag can stop a nested search.
keyPoints.bn: flag দিয়ে nested search-এর outer loop-ও থামানো যায়।

examQuestions.question: What does break leave?
examQuestions.answerHtml: The nearest enclosing loop or switch. Its target is the nearest breakable construct.

examQuestions.question: Where does continue go in a for loop?
examQuestions.answerHtml: To the update expression. The next condition follows the update.

12

Only one and two print before the break.

examQuestions.question: Read target 1 to 20. Search row and col from 1 to 3 in row-major order. After Input: print the first pair whose product equals target, separated by one space and newline. If no pair exists print None.
examQuestions.answerHtml:
#include <stdio.h>

int main(void)
{
    int target;
    printf("Input: ");
    if (scanf("%d", &target) != 1 || target < 1 || target > 20) {
        return 1;
    }
    int found = 0;
    for (int row = 1; row <= 3 && !found; row++) {
        for (int col = 1; col <= 3; col++) {
            if (row * col == target) {
                printf("%d %d\n", row, col);
                found = 1;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    if (!found) {
        puts("None");
    }
    return 0;
}

Carry the match state to the outer condition.
